newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Colgate/Clorox swap recommended.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Colgate/Clorox swap recommended.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Michael Grant said he recommended swapping into Colgate-Palmolive Co and out of Clorox Co based on the stocks' respective valuations.

-- said sees strong growth for both companies in 1997 "and thus we see no reason for the sizable valuation gap that recently has opened between the two names, with Clorox currently trading at a 21 percent premium to Colgate on our 1997 estimates," Morgan said
-- said expects Colgate, which is scheduled to post earnings Tuesday, to outperform the group based on accelerating operating momentum and its attractive valuation.
-- said raised its 12-18 month price target for Colgate to $115 from $108.
-- said Clorox has had an impressive performance recently and that that performance is reflected in its stock's premium valuation.
-- "At 24.2 times our calendar 1997 EPS estimate..., we see little reason to expect a further multiple upgrade for Clorox this year," he said.
-- Clorox shares were off 3-1/4 on light volume to 115-3/8 and Colgate shares were off 5/8 to 96-1/8 in late afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
